brief: public static Transformer getTransformer(ParseContext context) throws TikaException{}
method_comment:
* Returns the transformer specified in this parsing context. *

* If a transformer is not explicitly specified, then a default transformer * instance is created and returned. The default transformer instance is * configured to to use * {@link XMLConstants#FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING secure XML processing}. * * @return Transformer * @throws TikaException when the transformer can not be created
